messages:
Maya R.: Hey folks — first day! Laptop arrived but my monitor + USB-C dock show as delivered to 'Front Desk' in the tracker but I don't see them at my desk (4F-11). Also can't join 'Redwood-Staff' Wi-Fi: 802.1X authentication failed. I filed ticket #6129 but tagging IT here.

IT Helpdesk Bot: Thanks @Maya R.! Ticket #6129 created and assigned to Liam (IT). Expected response in ~30m. If urgent, mention @Liam (IT). :robot_face:

Liam (IT): Welcome, Maya! Can you paste the carrier tracking number? For Wi-Fi, try the guest network 'Redwood-Guest' and use the onboarding email link to get a temp passcode. Also what OS are you on (mac/windows)?

Maya R.: Tracking ZX123456789US showing 'Delivered to Front Desk' at 09:12. I'm on macOS 13.5.1.

George - Facilities: Hi @Liam @Maya R. — package ZX123456789US is on Mailroom shelf B under 'New Hires'. I can drop it at 4F in ~20m or you can pick it up. :package:

Sophia T.: If you want to skip the dock setup for now I have a spare USB-C hub you can borrow. I can leave it at your desk. :smile:

Liam (IT): Try joining Redwood-Guest while we sort this. On mac, if you get stuck, run in Terminal:

networksetup -setairportpower en0 off
sleep 2
networksetup -setairportpower en0 on

Then attempt to join. If an 802.1X prompt appears, choose 'Use System' and enter your SSO email + guest token. If you don't see the token, I'll DM it.

Maya R.: Ran the commands, still get the 802.1X popup that won't accept my corp password. I can't find any guest token in the onboarding email. Can you DM it?

Liam (IT): DMing the guest token now. Also escalating to Network to push a cert refresh for your account.

IT Helpdesk Bot: Note added: escalated to Network team (ticket NW-277).

Liam (IT): Network just pushed a certificate refresh. Try reconnecting now.

Maya R.: Connected! :tada: Also George just dropped off the monitor + dock — thanks all. Do I need to register the dock somewhere?

Liam (IT): No registration required. Dock is plug-and-play. If the external monitor doesn't show, open System Settings -> Displays -> Hold Option and click 'Detect Displays', or run:

sudo killall -HUP WindowServer

If anything odd, ping me and I can remote in.

Sophia T.: Welcome again @Maya R.! See you at the 4F stand-up.

Maya R.: Thanks everyone, saved my first-day setup :heart:
